topic: Mobile UX, Responsive Patterns, and Cross-Platform Design
learningObjectives: Apply mobile-first principles to interface layouts.
Adapt navigation and interactions for different device contexts.
Design consistent experiences across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

activities.title: Responsive Pattern Map
activities.instruction: Explore how interface patterns adapt across devices.

content.concept: Responsive design adapts layouts, navigation, controls, and content priorities to different screen sizes and contexts.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Mobile Navigation Lab
activities.instruction: Select the navigation pattern for each mobile task.

content.concept: Mobile navigation patterns should prioritize frequently used tasks while keeping important destinations discoverable.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Breakpoint Builder
activities.instruction: Adapt the layout across screen sizes.

content.concept: Breakpoints allow layouts to reorganize when available space changes significantly.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Touch Target Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust control sizes for comfortable interaction.

content.concept: Touch interfaces require controls with sufficient size and spacing to support accurate interaction on smaller screens.
